# Virtual DS4 public report data

- `descriptor.bin`, `usb-calibration.bin`, `pairing.bin`, `firmware.bin`:
  [LizardByte/libvirtualhid](https://github.com/LizardByte/libvirtualhid/tree/1aea6e37040205ad11cb8633f31ff876b5d7498d), commit
  `1aea6e37040205ad11cb8633f31ff876b5d7498d`, MIT library material only.
  Descriptor generated by `lvh::profiles::dualshock4_usb()` from
  `src/core/profiles.cpp`; feature arrays from
  `src/shared/playstation_feature_reports.hpp`.
- The descriptor upstream credits [cgutman/WinUHid](https://github.com/cgutman/WinUHid),
  copyright 2025 Cameron Gutman, MIT. Both notices are retained here.
- `vigem-calibration.bin`: feature report 0x02 from
  [ViGEmBus](https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/blob/d986e1d93708ec9b11049542fa6027272cce716c/sys/Ds4Pdo.cpp),
  commit `d986e1d93708ec9b11049542fa6027272cce716c`, BSD-3-Clause.

Only report data is used. No Windows driver, broker, GPL Sunshine source, or
source-available libvirtualhid component is included. The pairing MAC field is
zeroed in the stored template and replaced with a fresh locally administered
address for each owned virtual Linux device. The project computes inverse
sensor calibration from each backend's feature report rather than reusing
backend-specific numeric gains. Relevant notices are bundled by
`tools/licenses/generate.py` through `licenses/third-party/ds4-data.txt`.

To reproduce the descriptor, compile a C++23 program that calls
`lvh::profiles::dualshock4_usb()` and writes `report_descriptor` bytes, linking
that pinned repository's `src/core/profiles.cpp` and `src/core/types.cpp` with
its `src/include` directory. This is a data update procedure; normal builds do
not fetch or compile libvirtualhid.
